definitions.explanation: The prevention of heat transfer between areas, typically to maintain indoor temperature and improve energy efficiency in buildings.

examples.japanese: {断熱|だんねつ}{材|ざい}を{壁|かべ}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To install insulation material in the walls.

examples.japanese: {断熱|だんねつ}{性能|せいのう}の{高|たか}い{窓|まど}に{変|か}える。
examples.english: To replace with windows that have high insulation performance.

examples.japanese: {断熱|だんねつ}{工事|こうじ}で{冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}を{節約|せつやく}できる。
examples.english: Insulation work can save on heating and cooling costs.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {断|だん} (cut off, block) + {熱|ねつ} (heat). Literally "to block heat."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{断熱|だんねつ}{材|ざい} (insulation material)
・{断熱|だんねつ}{性能|せいのう} (insulation performance)
・{断熱|だんねつ}{工事|こうじ} (insulation work)
・{断熱|だんねつ}リフォーム (insulation renovation)
・{高|こう}{断熱|だんねつ} (high insulation)
・{断熱|だんねつ}ガラス (insulated glass)

ENERGY EFFICIENCY:
・{省|しょう}エネ (energy saving)
・ZEH ({ゼッチ}): Net Zero Energy House
・{気密性|きみつせい} (airtightness - often paired with insulation)

COMMON INSULATION MATERIALS:
・グラスウール (glass wool)
・ウレタンフォーム (urethane foam)
・セルロースファイバー (cellulose fiber)

RELATED TERMS:
・{防音|ぼうおん} (soundproofing)
・{防水|ぼうすい} (waterproofing)
・{遮熱|しゃねつ} (heat shielding - blocking radiant heat)
